title: Sean Duffy blames Friday's FAA outage on copper-to-fiber wiring work at a remote facility, saying contractor L3Harris may have installed a “faulty router”
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 12:17 PM ET, November 14, 2026.

summary: Joseph Pisani / Wall Street Journal : Sean Duffy blames Friday's FAA outage on copper-to-fiber wiring work at a remote facility, saying contractor L3Harris may have installed a “faulty router” — Work at a single remote location caused instability that led authorities to order nationwide groundstop;
